title: festuca scabrescens
intro: Festuca scabrescens, commonly known as rough fescue, is a type of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca scabrescens include wound healing, immune system modulation, and protection against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
